claim: Terminal alkynes undergo difunctionalization with AgF and NBS as the fluorine and bromine sources.
作者报告的最佳条件为2.5当量AgF、乙腈、80 °C和10小时。
在所述条件下，溴氟化产物以95%收率形成，且仅得到cis产物，并未检测到苯乙炔基溴化物2a'。
The reaction requires a stoichiometric amount of AgF rather than merely a catalytic quantity.
CsF/AgNO3体系仅产生痕量目标溴氟化产物，并以苯乙炔基溴化物2a'为主要副产物（86%）；pyridinium/Pd(OAc)2、CuF2/AgBF4和NiF2/AgNO3体系对该溴氟化无效。作者还报告若干常见氟源给出与前文相似的结果，但所给引文不足以确定这些结果的具体性质。
The terminal-alkyne scope included aryl alkynes bearing electron-donating or electron-withdrawing substituents and tolerated Cl, Br, F, CN, CF3, NO2, and OMe groups.
Ethynyltrimethylsilane failed to furnish a bromofluoroalkene and instead afforded fluorotrimethylsilane.
作者将反应扩展到取代芳基炔基酮等电子缺陷化合物；所考察的苯基炔基酮形成相应氟化产物，并报告了良好收率或高Z/E选择性。
A bromofluoroalkene reacted with phenylboronic acid to give a fluoroalkene bearing a new aryl substituent in 91% yield.
Direct fluorination experiments showed that both bromoalkynes and chloroalkynes gave fluorination products exclusively in good yields.

The authors propose formation of a bromoalkyne followed by a silver pi-complex, trans-addition of AgF to form a vinyl-silver intermediate, and protonation to furnish the Z bromofluoroalkene; they attribute regio- and stereoselectivity to backside fluoride attack.

The paper reports cationic Rh(I)/tetrafluoroborate-catalyzed cleavage of an acyl fluoride C-F bond and intramolecular addition across a tethered alkene, furnishing tertiary alkyl fluoride derivatives by 1,2-carbofluorination.
Acyl fluoride 1a gave insertion product 2a in 70% isolated yield under the reported standard conditions: 10 mol% [Rh(cod)2]BF4, 10 mol% dppbz, DCE, 90 °C, sealed vial.

Pd(0) and Ni(0) species failed to promote the desired insertion; no product formed without rhodium, neutral [RhCl(cod)]2 was inactive, and lowering the temperature to 70 °C gave no reaction. Omitting dppbz reduced rather than eliminated product formation.
在所报道体系中，作者考察的单取代烯烃和内烯烃未参与碳氟化；含短一个碳系链的底物 1m 得到酚衍生物 2m'，而非拟合成的六元环碳氟化产物 2m。

Tethered alkynes also underwent carbofluorination, but with six-membered 6-exo selectivity; a substrate bearing both an alkyne and alkene gave simple alkyne acylfluorination rather than the attempted tandem double cyclization.
Changing the rhodium counterion from BF4- to SbF6- prevented formation of 2a and instead gave alkene 2a' in 40% yield; adding one equivalent of nBu4NBF4 restored formation of 2a in 46% yield.

External-nucleophile trapping experiments produced Friedel-Crafts acylation products with anisole under either BF4- or SbF6-based cationic rhodium catalysis and allylated products with allylsilane under SbF6 conditions.

The authors propose that cationic rhodium abstracts fluoride from the acyl fluoride to form an acylium ion and Rh-F complex, the tethered alkene traps the acylium ion to form a cyclic tertiary carbocation, and BF4- supplies fluoride to the carbocation and functions as a fluoride shuttle.
Replacing the Rh/BF4/dppbz system with BF3·OEt2 did not furnish the carbofluorination product and instead produced a complicated mixture.

The tertiary alkyl fluoride product could undergo downstream C-S substitution with 4-bromobenzenethiol in 78% yield, while dehydrofluorination followed by palladium-catalyzed arylboronic-acid 1,4-addition gave an arylated product in 60% overall yield.
The α-trifluoromethylated ketone 3a underwent a Pd-catalyzed defluorination/arylation with phenylboronic acid to afford fluorinated α,β-unsaturated ketone 5 in 76% yield with high Z-selectivity.
The reported Pd defluorination/arylation conditions used 3a, phenylboronic acid, 5 mol% Pd(PPh)3Cl2, three equivalents of K3PO4, toluene, and 110 °C.

The paper's main transformation constructs α-CF3 carbonyl compounds by fluoroaroylation of gem-difluoroalkenes with aroyl fluorides under cooperative photoredox and NHC catalysis; the aroyl fluoride supplies both the aroyl group and fluoride.
Scheme 2所用条件包括2 mol%指定铱光催化剂、20 mol% NHC N1、12.5 mol% Cs2CO3、乙腈、405 nm LED照射24小时；所列收率为分离收率。

The amount and identity of base strongly affected the fluoroaroylation: K2HPO4 and Na2CO3 gave no product, DMAP gave only trace product, and 12.5 mol% Cs2CO3 gave 3a in 96% yield while nearly suppressing side product 3a'.
Control experiments showed that the photoredox catalyst, NHC catalyst, and light irradiation were each indispensable for formation of the desired fluoroaroylation product.
带烷氧基、吡唑基或烷硫基取代的活化偕二氟烯烃可生成相应产物，收率为50–82%；所测试的芳环对位带氰基、硝基或酰基的偕二氟烯烃在该反应中不活泼，作者将其归因于这些底物在所用条件下未被氧化。
A range of substituted and heteroaromatic aroyl fluorides participated, but aliphatic acyl fluorides were not eligible substrates.
TEMPO completely suppressed the model reaction, and a TEMPO adduct was detected by HRMS, supporting involvement of an α-trifluoromethylated benzyl radical intermediate.

A preformed acyl azolium furnished product in the absence of added NHC when fluoride was supplied, and Stern–Volmer studies showed that both the gem-difluoroalkene and acyl azolium quenched the excited photocatalyst, with substantially stronger quenching by the gem-difluoroalkene.

The authors propose SET oxidation of the gem-difluoroalkene, regioselective fluoride trapping to form a benzylic radical, formation and reduction of an acyl azolium to a ketyl-type radical, and radical–radical coupling followed by NHC fragmentation.

NHC gold bifluoride complexes catalyzed hydrofluorination of symmetrical and unsymmetrical alkynes to give fluorinated stilbene analogues and fluorovinyl thioethers in good to excellent yields with high stereo- and regioselectivity.

For symmetrical alkynes, the optimized conditions used gold bifluoride complex 2e or 2f in CH2Cl2 at 50 °C in a sealed plastic vial; the reported Scheme 5 conditions specify 2e at 2 mol %, NEt3·3HF at 3 equivalents, and NH4BF4 at 1.5 equivalents.

The symmetrical-alkyne reaction tolerated bulky groups and meta- or para-positioned electron-withdrawing and electron-donating groups, but ortho-substituted alkynes showed no reactivity; only Z products were observed.
Unsymmetrical alkynes gave only Z stereoisomers in early tests, but elevated temperature reduced regioselectivity; reactions were therefore run at room temperature for five days.
For unsymmetrical alkynes, the method differentiated alkyl and aryl groups selectively, while one enone-forming example lacked complete regioselectivity but still gave an isolable major product.

Alkynyl sulfides that failed under several literature procedures were hydrofluorinated by the reported gold-bifluoride protocol, providing fluorovinyl thioethers in good yields and excellent stereoselectivities at room temperature.

For alkynyl sulfides, elevated temperatures produced multiple product isomers, and thermal instability or partial decomposition of substrates and products could reduce yields even at room temperature; NH4BF4 was not beneficial for these cases.
Replacing the NEt3 ligand of the gold bifluoride catalyst with pyridine or a selenium ligand gave poorer hydrofluorination results.

Gold bifluoride 2a was converted fully to monofluoride 3 within four hours upon treatment with a stoichiometric base, and diluted NEt3·3HF rapidly regenerated 2a from 3; however, the source conflicts on whether the base in the monitored conversion was KOtBu or KOH.
The authors describe the transformation as fluoride-promoted in situ generation of an aryl nucleophile followed by stepwise nucleophilic aromatic substitution.
在初始条件下，催化量CsF与18-crown-6在THF中使反应于2小时后以77%收率得到联芳基3aa。
The optimized CsF/DMF conditions produced 3aa in less than five minutes in 92% calibrated GLC yield and 79% isolated yield, while the absence of initiator gave no reaction after 24 h.
Removing 18-crown-6 improved selectivity for the desired coupling product but increased reaction time; DMF then provided good selectivity and faster additive-free reaction kinetics.
该反应兼容多种给电子和吸电子官能团；带有氰基、甲氧羰基、硝基或三氟甲基取代基的二氮烯能够被有效转移。
Iodo- and bromo-substituted aryl nucleophiles underwent some competing halogen-metal exchange, producing small quantities of dihalogenated benzene derivatives and 1,4-bis(pentafluorophenyl)benzene.

For functionalized polyfluoroarenes, DMF gave better regiocontrol than ethereal solvents; reactions in DMF generally favored para or beta substitution with good-to-moderate selectivity, and regioisomerically pure products were obtained after chromatography.
在所述不适用实例中，五氟苯甲醚反应不佳且二氮烯1h迅速分解为相应芳基硅烷；氯五氟苯主要发生卤素-金属交换；五氟苯被去质子化后进一步分解；1,2-二氟苯则经去质子化并加成到反应溶剂而发生邻位甲酰化。
掩蔽芳基亲核试剂二氮烯1a在路易斯碱活化后易降解为相应芳基硅烷；减少氟代芳烃2a的用量会增加双芳基化产物4a。
The authors propose stabilized Meisenheimer-type intermediates in the stepwise SNAr pathway.
The paper reports a transition-metal-free, chemoselective coupling of sufficiently electron-deficient fluorinated arenes with functionalized N-aryl-N'-silyldiazenes as masked aryl nucleophiles.
The transformation generates the aryl nucleophile in situ under fluoride promotion and then forms the coupling product by nucleophilic aromatic substitution.
The selected optimized experiment used CsF in DMF and furnished product 3aa in less than five minutes, with 92% yield by calibrated GLC and 79% isolated yield.
No reaction occurred in the absence of a fluoride-based initiator under the reported control conditions.
The aryl pronucleophile scope tolerated electron-donating and electron-withdrawing groups, including cyano, methoxycarbonyl, nitro, and trifluoromethyl substituents.

For functionalized polyfluoroarenes, reactions in DMF produced the para- or beta-substituted regioisomer with good-to-moderate selectivity, and regioisomerically pure products were obtained after chromatography.
使用三倍过量的氟代芳烃 2a 时，仅形成少量区域异构体混合物形式的三联苯 4a；减少 2a 的用量会增加双芳基化 4a 的形成。
Activation of the silyldiazene can competitively produce the corresponding arylsilane, and omitting 18-crown-6 improved selectivity against this degradation pathway while prolonging reaction time.
Iodo- and bromo-substituted aryl nucleophiles underwent competitive halogen-metal exchange, producing small quantities of dihalogenated benzene derivatives and 1,4-bis(pentafluorophenyl)benzene.

Reported unsuitable electrophiles exhibited poor reaction or competing decomposition: pentafluoroanisole reacted poorly with diazene decomposition, chloropentafluorobenzene mainly underwent halogen-metal exchange to oligomeric mixtures, and pentafluorobenzene was deprotonated and decomposed.
作者在所引机理表述中提出稳定化 Meisenheimer 型中间体可能参与反应。

Treatment of [Au(F)(SPhos)] with excess 1-phenyl-1-propyne formed the fluorovinyl gold complex [Au(PhC=C(F)CH3)(SPhos)], demonstrating stoichiometric formation of a C-F and Au-C substituted vinyl species from an alkyne and a gold fluorido complex.
Adding HCl to fluorovinyl complex 2 caused protodeauration and produced (Z)-2-fluoro-1-phenylpropene while retaining the regio- and stereochemical relationship of the vinyl complex.

Internal-alkyne reactivity depended strongly on substrate and conditions: diphenylacetylene required excess substrate and 50 °C; 3-hexyne reached 50% conversion at 50 °C and decomposed upon further heating; 1,1,1,4,4,4-hexafluorobutyne did not give an observed vinyl complex even at elevated temperature.
The carbonyl-substituted alkyne 4-phenyl-3-butyn-2-one underwent quantitative formation of fluorovinyl complex 13 after 3 h at room temperature, as observed by NMR spectroscopy.

Competitive experiments established preferential fluorovinyl-complex formation from 4-phenyl-3-butyn-2-one over 1-phenyl-1-propyne: with one equivalent of each alkyne, complexes 2 and 13 formed in a 1:11 ratio, and with ten equivalents of each only 13 was observed.

Terminal 1-hexyne followed a competing pathway: one equivalent cleanly formed an alkynyl gold complex rather than an observed metal-bound fluorovinyl complex, whereas excess 1-hexyne also produced 2-fluoro-1-hexene.

A cationic [Au(SPhos)]+ complex reacted with 4-phenyl-3-butyn-2-one and TMAF to form fluorovinyl complex 13 rather than [Au(F)(SPhos)]; the experimental procedure used excess alkyne and TMAF and sonication for 1 h.
Omitting 2-chlorobenzoic acid increased hydrofluorination yields for most tested catalysts without substantially changing the regioisomer ratio, but [Au(SPhos)][B(C6F5)4] was an exception.
作者讨论了两种可能的氢氟化机理：炔烃插入Au-F键，或对金配位炔烃进行外球亲核氟化；作者认为文献及配合物17存在下的氟离子进攻实验支持后一种可能。作者进一步提出，形成乙烯基金物种后可经脱金质子化生成氢氟化产物并完成催化循环。
该论文报道了膦催化的炔烃分子间碳氟化反应，以酰氟作为氟化试剂，在无需过渡金属催化剂的条件下合成高度取代的单氟烯烃衍生物。
Under the optimized conditions, acyl fluoride 4a and alkynoate 5a reacted with 30 mol% PCy3 in toluene at room temperature to give monofluoroalkene 6aa in 74% isolated yield.
PCy3 was uniquely effective in catalyst screening; other tested phosphines, DMAP, DABCO, and an N-heterocyclic carbene failed or gave only low yields.
The acyl fluoride scope included electron-neutral, electron-deficient, electron-rich, halo-substituted, heteroaryl, and pi-extended aryl substrates; the electron-rich substrate required 72 hours.

Aromatic and selected heteroaryl alkynoates were compatible, whereas aliphatic alkynoates bearing n-pentyl, cyclopropyl, or tert-butyl groups failed to form the corresponding carbo-fluorinated products.
The representative product 6aa was obtained as a 1:1.2 E/Z mixture, and the authors observed reversible PCy3 addition-elimination that interconverted the isomers under the catalytic conditions.
External CsF and TBAT did not promote carbo fluorination of 4b and 5a, providing a control against a mechanism based on an external fluoride source.

A postulated P(V) intermediate was not observed by 19F NMR in toluene-d8, although product 6ba formed in 43% yield; in CD3CN, appreciable 6ba was not formed and PCy3F2 and hydroacylation product 9 were instead obtained.
作者提出五配位氟代磷烷是氟化步骤的关键中间体：轴向P-F键断裂并使氟迁移至β-碳形成两性离子中间体INT2，随后C-P键断裂并释放PCy3生成氟化产物。

Calculations found the modeled PMe3 pathway less favorable than the PCy3 pathway in both kinetic and thermodynamic terms, and the authors attribute a facilitating role to the steric bulk of PCy3, particularly for C-P bond cleavage.

The reported reaction is a phosphine-catalyzed intermolecular carbofluorination of alkynes using acyl fluorides as fluorinating reagents, producing highly substituted monofluoroalkenes without a transition-metal catalyst.
Under the identified room-temperature conditions, acyl fluoride 4a and alkynoate 5a with 30 mol% PCy3 in toluene afforded monofluoroalkene 6aa in 74% isolated yield.
PCy3 was uniquely effective in the reported catalyst screening; the other tested phosphines, DMAP, DABCO, and an N-heterocyclic carbene did not effectively promote the reaction.
The acyl fluoride scope included electron-neutral, electron-deficient, electron-rich, halogenated, heteroaryl, and pi-extended aryl substrates; the electron-rich substrate required 72 hours.

Aromatic and selected heteroaryl alkynoates were compatible, whereas the tested aliphatic alkynoates bearing n-pentyl, cyclopropyl, or tert-butyl substituents failed to form the corresponding carbofluorinated products.
代表性碳氟化产物以低E/Z选择性形成，并可在所用催化条件下经PCy3的可逆加成-消除发生异构体互变；使用2-吡啶基取代炔酸酯5h时，所列产物6kh、6ah和6gh表现出高Z选择性。
External CsF and TBAT failed to promote carbofluorination of 4b and 5a; the authors used this result to reject the tested alternative fluoride-mediated pathway.

The postulated P(V) intermediate was not directly observed by 19F NMR in toluene-d8; product 6ba formed in 43% yield, which the authors interpreted as indicating that ligand coupling was faster than intermediate formation.

Changing the solvent from toluene-d8 to CD3CN suppressed appreciable formation of 6ba and instead produced PCy3F2 and hydroacylated product 9 in 28% and 34% yield, respectively; the authors associated the polar-solvent outcome with ionization and decomposition of the proposed fluorophosphorane.
The reaction was demonstrated on gram scale using an acyl fluoride generated in situ from acyl chloride 10 and KF, affording monofluoroalkene 6ca in 57% yield.
The authors achieved a Ru-catalyzed redox-neutral [4+2] cyclization of 2-arylbenzimidazoles with α-trifluoromethyl-α-diazoketones through sequential C−H activation and defluorinative annulation.
该环化涉及三氟甲基的两次C−F键断裂，同时羰基保持不变。
The reported optimal conditions were [RuCl2(p-cymene)]2 (5 mol%), KOAc (50 mol%), TFE, 100 °C, and 16 h, affording 4a in 82% yield.
The structure of product 4a was confirmed by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
A 7% trifluoroethoxylated byproduct formed by nucleophilic substitution of 4a by TFE, and a C−H alkylation product formed under a different Rh/Ag catalytic system.

The benzimidazole scope included electronically varied aryl substituents, halogenated substituents, disubstituted and fused-ring substrates, and a thiophene-containing substrate; a 4-pyridyl substrate was unreactive.
The authors attributed the lack of reactivity of 2-(4-pyridyl)benzimidazole to possible strong coordination of the pyridine ring to the ruthenium catalyst.

The fluorinated diazoketone scope included aryl and aliphatic substituents; electron-donating aryl substituents were generally less reactive, a p-OMe example gave a poor result, and cyclic aliphatic examples gave products in 53–92% yields without ring opening.

The proposed mechanism proceeds through Ru-mediated C−H activation, diazo coordination and N2 extrusion to a Ru carbene, migratory insertion, and an α-CF3 ketone intermediate V; the authors favor base-promoted dehydrofluorination to gem-difluorovinyl ketone VI over direct β-fluoride elimination, followed by intramolecular nucleophilic addition–elimination.

An intermolecular reaction of 3,3,3-trifluoro-1,2-diphenylpropan-1-one with 2-methylimidazole demonstrated access from an α-CF3 carbonyl analogue of intermediate V to product, and methylimidazole served both as substrate and basic promoter for HF elimination.

The monofluorinated product 4a underwent C(sp2)−F substitution with oxygen, nitrogen, carbon, and sulfur nucleophiles; ethyl glycolate and methyl thioglycolate additionally gave fused pentacyclic products under excess base.
在所引模型反应中，使用CuCl2和Cy2NMe、以MeCN为溶剂并在25 °C反应24 h，得到乙基(Z)-2-氟-4-氧代-4-苯基丁-2-烯酸酯3，19F NMR收率为73%，Z/E >22:1。

CuCl2, Cy2NMe, and air were required for productive model-reaction conversion: omission of CuCl2 or Cy2NMe and use of an N2 atmosphere each gave no reaction, while omission of PPh3 lowered rather than abolished the yield.

The fluoroalkylation accommodated styrene-type olefins with varied substitution and functional groups, including amines, halides, alcohols, silanes, boronic esters, alkenes, and alkynes, affording beta-fluoroenone products in moderate to good yields.
Olefin substitution altered defluorination selectivity: (E)-beta-methylstyrenes gave non-defluorinated products, whereas 1,1-disubstituted and 1,1,2-trisubstituted styrenes gave Heck-type products.
在当前条件下，所测试的非活化烯烃转化效率低并通常回收超过90%的起始物；4-乙烯基吡啶也未能有效转化，作者提出其可能作为配体干扰金属催化体系；所测试的1,3-烯炔和联烯产生了复杂反应混合物。

Most other alkyl bromides were inefficient, with aminomethylation or E2-elimination by-products detected by HRMS, and switching to the tested more electrophilic Michael acceptors did not restore reactivity.

Radical scavengers inhibited the reaction and radical adducts were characterized; a radical-clock substrate furnished a ring-expanded product in 40% yield alongside 33% of product 3, providing experimental support for radical intermediates.
The authors interpret detection of intermediate 30 under modified conditions as support for conversion of that intermediate to beta-fluoroenone 3 by dehydrofluorination.
电化学测量显示Cy2NMe和CuCl2的氧化峰分别为+0.71 V和+0.61 V（相对于Ag/AgCl），CuCl2与PPh3混合后出现+0.99 V的新峰；所引31P NMR谱仅显示约27 ppm的OPPh3信号，未检测到未反应PPh3，作者据此判断PPh3已完全氧化。

The proposed cycle invokes Cu(II)-mediated oxidation of Cy2NMe, deprotonation to an alpha-aminoalkyl radical, XAT from ethyl bromodifluoroacetate, radical addition to styrene, oxygen/copper recombination and rearrangement to intermediate 30, followed by Cy2NMe-promoted dehydrofluorination to the Z-beta-fluoroenone.
The authors developed a multivariate linear regression model for predicting Mayr nucleophilicity parameters across different nucleophile classes and solvents using 341 data points.
The modeled data set included C-, N-, O-, and S-centered nucleophile classes, including neutral and anionic species.
The nucleophile data covered 35 Mayr N units and seven solvents: DCM, ACN, THF, acetone, DMF, DMSO, and water.

Proton affinity alone did not provide a common correlation for all nucleophiles: anionic nucleophiles followed a separate trend, while adding solvation descriptors allowed all nucleophiles to be retained in one correlation.
The final model had R2 = 0.935, leave-one-out Q2 = 0.927, average two-fold Q2 = 0.922, and training-set RMSE = 1.41; external validation gave R2 = 0.946 and RMSE = 1.40.
Prediction error increased approximately with nucleophilicity, making anionic nucleophiles more challenging to predict.
Steric terms in the model are specific to reactions with benzhydrylium cations or related quinone methides and are not a general representation of nucleophile steric hindrance.
The model is fundamentally thermodynamic and therefore has a stated limitation because intrinsic kinetic barriers can be non-negligible, particularly for ambident reactivity.
The authors identify proton affinity and solvation energies of the nucleophile and addition product as the main model parameters affecting nucleophilicity.
Mayr N alone is an average-reactivity approximation because relative rates also depend on nucleophile sensitivity sN and can reverse with electrophile identity.
